default.notes: A visa must be obtained in advance through a Libyan mission, backed by an approved invitation from a Libyan sponsor or accredited tour operator; issuance is limited and slow while the security situation persists.

groups.notes: Visa-free under bilateral and Arab agreements, commonly reported as up to 90 days — airport and land-border practice varies with the security situation, so confirm before travel.

IL.notes: Israeli passport holders are not admitted to Libya, and evidence of travel to Israel in any passport can also lead to refusal.

LY.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Libyan citizens.
